summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing for OutfitDuel Sprint 1. All 17 backend pytest tests pass (100%). Frontend e2e flow (home → create → vote → reveal → 3s CTA → result page toggles → privacy → anti-duplicate vote) works end-to-end with no errors.

minor.issue: Two redundant sort() calls (line 342-343) — the first sort is overwritten by the second. Harmless but dead code.

Title/description are interpolated into HTML without HTML-escaping (line 489-498). If a user-supplied question contains '<' or '"' it could break the OG tags or enable HTML injection in the share preview page.
Compression check passes (1600px source → 1200px served). All good.

issues: After voting, the unchosen photo is hidden by an overlay so only the winning photo card remains visually prominent — verify this is intended product behavior (screenshots show only photo A visible after voting A, with bars 100%/0%).

action_items: (Optional, low priority) HTML-escape duel.question/description in /api/share/duel/{id} response to prevent OG tag breakage/injection on arbitrary user input.
(Optional, dead code) Remove redundant first sort() call in /api/duels/popular handler.
(Design check) Confirm whether hiding the losing photo after vote on /duel/:id is intentional — currently only the chosen photo's card remains in view.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 530 lines — still manageable but approaching the suggested 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into routers/duels.py, routers/share.py, services/email.py as the app grows.

Anti-duplicate vote uses OR(voter_hash, cookie_id) which is correct, but voter_hash uses request.client.host directly. Behind k8s ingress this may collapse many real users behind a single egress IP and over-block legitimate voters. Consider trusting X-Forwarded-For (first hop) when present.
/api/share/duel HTML response does not HTML-escape user-supplied 'question' (XSS / OG-break vector).
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded from all responses via projection — good.
create_duel uses request: Request but never reads it; minor unused-arg.

Background expire_duels_loop runs every 5 minutes — fine for MVP, but no guard against multiple workers; if scaled horizontally each replica would attempt to send emails (would be deduped by result_email_sent flag, so safe).
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates 2-3 throwaway duels (id starts random; question prefixed 'TEST_'). The delete-token test cleans up its own duel. Other test duels remain but expire in 48h.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and covers all Sprint 1 endpoints including OG share, uploads compression check, anti-duplicate vote, delete-token auth, weekly stats floor, popular feed, 404s, invalid choice rejection, and question 80-char truncation. Frontend was tested on mobile viewport (390x844) using real file uploads via Pillow-generated JPEGs. Anti-duplicate vote relies on both IP-hash AND cookie; from a single test session both signals collapse to one voter — duplicate POST returns 409 with detail 'Je hebt al gestemd'. Resend email is intentional NO-OP (RESEND_API_KEY empty).
